(Currently amended) Claim 12: A welding wire and container assembly, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a cylindrical wall having a first end and a second end, wherein the cylindrical wall comprises a plurality of triangular portions folded radially inward at the second end; a support structure coupled to the plurality of triangular portions to provide a layered end assembly, the layered end assembly having a base that supports a coil of welding wire disposed in the housing.

(Currently amended) Claim 16: The assembly of claim 12, wherein the triangular portions generally meet at a central axis defined within the cylindrical wall. 

(Currently amended) Claim 17: The assembly of claim 12, wherein the layered end assembly comprises a plurality of support structures laminated with the plurality of triangular portions, the support structures integrated with the triangular portions to create a reinforcement.
